verdict.rationale: Airwallex's first-party docs show all three pillars in one platform. Spend is covered by corporate cards with spend controls and authorization rules plus card expense sync. Bill pay is covered by the Bills API, accounts payable and transfers/batch payouts. Banking is covered by a business account, multi-currency Global Accounts and FX. The spend overview explicitly frames expenses and AP together. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that founders actually replace point solutions with it, and explicit evidence of a unified single-dashboard experience or migration path from existing tools.
